y_voice_1.kind: 旧take(読み違い疑い・非推奨)
y_voice_1.openai_asr: When I leave a note saying no one was home, I feel a little sad too, but then I go to the next house. I really want fewer re-deliveries. They are hard on us too. Even so, I can't simply say customers should pay the cost. I think the cost should be part of the general fee for carrying packages. That makes more sense than charging each person who is not home for their re-delivery. I want the company to think about whether free delivery for online orders should stay as it is. If it changes delivery fees, I want it to look at how it sets them too. Then the money can really reach the people who deliver packages.
